name: 21144 · Severn, MD
findings: ZIP 21144 (Severn) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21144 (Severn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 21144 (Severn) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
